title: The “Right” Discourse on Migration: Analysing Migration-Related Tweets in Right and Far-Right Political Movements
reasoning: The paper focuses on analyzing far-right political discourse on Twitter regarding migration using NLP. While it identifies 'identity attacks' and mentions religious groups (e.g., Muslims), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, ethics, or moral reasoning systems in LLMs; rather, it uses an LLM as a tool to label topics in human-generated text.
